note: Thresholds are transcribed from the hand-off TEST_PROTOCOL.md and must not be widened. A change requires an explicit scope decision, a changelog entry, a re-freeze and invalidation of every downstream PASS.

thresholds.near_zero_rule: reference_norm < 1e-6 => judge by absolute error, never by cosine
thresholds.invalid_outputs: NaN, Inf, shape mismatch, mean-only comparison, implicit dtype downgrade all FAIL

recipe_contract.recipe_none_fallback: plain PI0.5 prompt; FAST loss rejected while recipe is None
recipe_contract.blend_selection: replay the reference selection mechanism, do not re-derive weights

config_matrix.fast_offset_note: 1152 is the default; a checkpoint declaring 128 keeps its own declared mapping. Neither may be silently remapped, and the 2048 residual table used by the Scene1 policy is not part of this contract.

tiny_model.note: The reference hardcodes the SigLIP projection to 2048 and only matches a gemma_2b language tower. Using gemma_300m as the VLM raises 'Sizes of tensors must match ... Expected size 2048 but got size 1024' in `embed_prefix`, so the smallest valid pairing is the default 2b + 300m pair. Numerical gates reduce the batch, never the architecture.

text_ce.reduction: mean over all valid target tokens in the batch, then as configured

fast_ce.reduction: mean within each valid sample, then mean across samples
fast_ce.difference_from_text: text averages over tokens globally; FAST averages per sample first
fast_ce.non_code_positions: Action:/BOS/terminator retained but excluded from CE
fast_ce.padding: excluded from CE and from the denominator

flow.loss_dims: actual action dimensions only; padded dimensions excluded
flow.reduction_none: per-sample result available and compared independently

loss_semantics.combined: default 10 * flow + 1 * text + 1 * fast with KI isolating only the flow path

head_sharing.policy: read from the actual checkpoint at G0 and preserved exactly
head_sharing.requirement: an independently trained language head must never be dropped; a tied head must never be duplicated
head_sharing.enforcement: strict load fails on any missing or unexpected tensor

optimizer_semantics.none_gradient_rule: a PyTorch group whose grad is None must not update parameters, momentum or group counters on that step; JAX zero-gradient + AdamW is not automatically equivalent
optimizer_semantics.schedule: cosine decay with warmup; auto-scales warmup/decay when total steps are shorter than the configured decay steps
optimizer_semantics.dtype: float32 parameters, gradients and optimizer state

training_contract.scheduler_short_run_scaling: verified against the reference, not assumed
training_contract.resume: parameters, optimizer state, RNG, step, sampling cursor/order, scheduler and EMA-if-enabled are identical after resume
training_contract.ema: disabled by default; if enabled, resume must restore it too

rejected_config_combinations: knowledge_insulation=false with flex/manual attention or flashrt adarms
rejection_table.behaviour: raise a clear error; never silently change default behaviour
reference_limitations: paligemma_variant=gemma_300m is accepted by the config validator but fails in `embed_prefix`: the SigLIP projection is fixed at 2048 and a 300m language tower embeds at 1024. The candidate must replicate the failure rather than invent a working 300m VLM.

g7_resource_eligibility.rule: record actual measurements; a shortfall keeps G7 BLOCKED and must never be worked around by freezing the VLM, LoRA, fewer draws or lower precision
g7_resource_eligibility.accounting: 16 * N bytes for FP32 params, grads and two AdamW moments, excluding activations, KV cache and temporaries
g7_resource_eligibility.verdict: measured at G0 and re-measured at G7

per_stage_negative_controls.G1: swap action dimension order and FAST offset
per_stage_negative_controls.G2: drop a parameter and transpose an axis
per_stage_negative_controls.G3: remove stop_gradient, expose FAST to the action block, corrupt RoPE
per_stage_negative_controls.G4: change reduction and disable a loss
per_stage_negative_controls.G5: skip optimizer restore and decay an inactive group
per_stage_negative_controls.G6: use the wrong normalization and select a padding position
per_stage_negative_controls.G7: change input identity and drop state

anti_cheat.rule: each control must make the corresponding test fail; zero-output equality is not a pass
